items.b: FOUR ROLEX DAYTONAS MAKE £37.3M AT PHILLIPS IN LONDON
items.t: The one-off Cosmograph Daytonas sold individually on 28 September for the Federer Foundation and Re:wild. The four sterling prices add to the reported total exactly; the four dollar conversions add to $49.37m against a reported $49.5m.

items.b: 23.34-CARAT YELLOW DIAMOND TOPS PHILLIPS HONG KONG AT HKD 4.3M
items.t: The fancy-intense-yellow VVS1 ring sold in line with its high estimate on 29 September, taking 11.6% of a sale that made HKD 37.2m from 91 lots. Two of the top five sold under their low estimate.

items.b: CHOW SANG SANG GOLD READS 1,245 YUAN, 11.6% OFF 25 AUGUST
items.t: Three Chinese brand counters read 1,242 to 1,246 yuan a gram on 29 September, each down 163 to 165 yuan from the high Carat Capital recorded on 27 August. Spot gold has since risen to $4,191.60.
